The dentist uses a small mechanical tool to clean the teeth and then applies a blue barrier gel to the gums using a syringe-like applicator. The cold light machine is then positioned over the mouth, and the patient is seen wearing red protective goggles. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing the teeth before and after the treatment next to a professional shade guide. The video ends with the patient smiling brightly into a hand mirror and taking a selfie with the dentist.
